LESSON: READING 12.2.1 COMPREHENSION

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 12
Topic 12.2: Reading 12.2.1 Comprehension
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Reading 12.2.1 Comprehension, part of Strand 12 in SNE  /  physical-impairment / Grade two General.

Key inquiry question: What makes a story interesting? 2. How can we tell where events have taken place?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Reading 12.2.1 Comprehension together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Critical thinking and problem solving is enhanced as the learner makes predictions on the outcomes of the story based on pictures and the title..

Communication and Collaboration –is enhanced as the learner talks about the character and setting of the story with peers.

Values:
Respect is enhanced as the learner appreciates the opinions of others during group discussions.

Link to

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills (self-esteem) as the learner is able to retell the story.

Link to other Learning Areas:

Comprehension skills are essential in all learning areas.

Suggested Learning Resources:

Pictures, assistive technology such as universal cuffs/wrist braces/arm braces, weighted pencil/pen grips, page-turners, adapted digital devices

Other Related Service Providers: Resource person, speech therapist, Learner support assistance, Occupational Therapist, Physiotherapist.
